title: RBAC access audit (who has what)
description: Provides comprehensive visibility into access grants, highlighting over-privileged accounts and stale assignments.
example_prompt: "List all role assignments across subscription '{subscription_name}'. For each, show: principal name, principal type (user/group/SP), role, scope, assignment source (direct/inherited). Flag: (1) Owner/Contributor at subscription scope, (2) assignments to individual users (should be groups), (3) assignments where principal no longer exists in Entra ID."
